intro.en: Two friends, Faisal and Jaafar, talk about a bank robbery they saw on the news. You will learn words about crime and safety, and how to thank Allah for the blessing of security.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Faisal aur Jaafar bank ki chori ki khabar par baat karte hain. Hum jurm aur amn se mutalliq alfaaz seekhenge aur yeh bhi ke amn ki nemat par Allah ka shukr kaise karte hain.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ صَديقانِ، فَيْصَلٌ وَجَعْفَرٌ، عَنْ سَرِقَةِ مَصْرِفٍ شاهَداها في الأَخْبارِ. سَتَتَعَلَّمُ كَلِماتٍ عَنِ الجَريمَةِ وَالأَمْنِ، وَكَيْفَ نَشْكُرُ اللهَ عَلى نِعْمَةِ الأَمْنِ.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati ho.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salām
dialogue.en: And peace be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aur aap par bhi salamati ho.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ شاهَدْتَ الأَخْبارَ في التِّلْفازِ أَمْسِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal shāhadta l-akhbāra fi t-tilfāzi amsi?
dialogue.en: Did you watch the news on TV yesterday?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ne kal TV par khabrein dekhi thin?

dialogue.ar: تَقْصِدُ حادِثَ سَرِقَةِ المَصْرِفِ الوَطَنِيِّ؟
dialogue.tr: taqṣidu ḥāditha sariqati l-maṣrifi l-waṭaniyy?
dialogue.en: Do you mean the theft at the National Bank?
dialogue.ur: Aap National Bank ki chori ka waqia keh rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، لَقَدْ أَخافَنِي ذَلِكَ الحادِثُ كَثيراً. لَمْ تَكُنْ بِلادُنا تَعْرِفُ هَذا النَّوْعَ مِنَ الجَريمَةِ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, laqad akhāfanī dhālika l-ḥādithu kathīran. lam takun bilādunā taʿrifu hādha n-nawʿa mina l-jarīmati min qablu
dialogue.en: Yes, that incident scared me a lot. Our country had never known this kind of crime before.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, us waqie ne mujhe bahut dara diya. Hamara mulk pehle is qism ke jurm se waqif nahin tha.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّنِي شَعَرْتُ بِالاطْمِئْنانِ عِنْدَما قَبَضَتِ الشُّرْطَةُ عَلَى الجُناةِ بَعْدَ ساعاتٍ.
dialogue.tr: lākinnanī shaʿartu bi-l-iṭmiʾnāni ʿindamā qabaḍati sh-shurṭatu ʿalā l-junāti baʿda sāʿāt
dialogue.en: But I felt reassured when the police arrested the criminals after a few hours.
dialogue.ur: Lekin mujhe sukoon mila jab police ne chand ghanton baad mujrimon ko pakad liya.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ زادَتِ الجَريمَةُ عِنْدَنا أَخيراً.
dialogue.tr: laqad zādati l-jarīmatu ʿindanā akhīran
dialogue.en: Crime has recently increased in our country.
dialogue.ur: Hamare yahan haal hi mein jurm barh gaya hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّها ما زالَتْ قَليلَةً مُقارَنَةً بِالدُّوَلِ الأُخْرى.
dialogue.tr: wa-lākinnahā mā zālat qalīlatan muqāranatan bi-d-duwali l-ukhrā
dialogue.en: But it is still low compared with other countries.
dialogue.ur: Lekin doosre mulkon ke muqable mein abhi bhi kam hai.

dialogue.ar: أَتَّفِقُ مَعَكَ، فَقَدْ قَضَيْتُ العُطْلَةَ الماضِيَةَ في إِحْدَى الدُّوَلِ الكُبْرى. لَمْ نَكُنْ نَخْرُجُ مِنَ الفُنْدُقِ بَعْدَ غُروبِ الشَّمْسِ، خَوْفاً مِنْ حَوادِثِ السَّرِقَةِ وَالقَتْلِ.
dialogue.tr: attafiqu maʿaka, faqad qaḍaytu l-ʿuṭlata l-māḍiyata fī iḥdā d-duwali l-kubrā. lam nakun nakhruju mina l-funduqi baʿda ghurūbi sh-shamsi, khawfan min ḥawādithi s-sariqati wa-l-qatl
dialogue.en: I agree with you. I spent last holiday in one of the big countries. We did not leave the hotel after sunset, for fear of theft and murder.
dialogue.ur: Main aap se mutafiq hoon. Pichhli chhuttiyan maine ek bade mulk mein guzari. Hum suraj doobne ke baad hotel se nahin nikalte the, chori aur qatl ke dar se.

dialogue.ar: بَلْ تَقَعُ الجَريمَةُ – أَحْياناً – في تِلْكَ البِلادِ في النَّهارِ.
dialogue.tr: bal taqaʿu l-jarīmatu – aḥyānan – fī tilka l-bilādi fi n-nahār
dialogue.en: In fact crime sometimes happens in those countries even during the day.
dialogue.ur: Balkeh un mulkon mein kabhi kabhi jurm din mein bhi hota hai.

dialogue.ar: أَخافُ أَنْ تَنْتَقِلَ العَدْوَى إِلى بِلادِنا، فَتَنْتَشِرَ جَرائِمُ القَتْلِ وَالاغْتِصابِ.
dialogue.tr: akhāfu an tantaqila l-ʿadwā ilā bilādinā, fa-tantashira jarāʾimu l-qatli wa-l-ightiṣāb
dialogue.en: I fear the infection will move to our country and crimes of murder and rape will spread.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe dar hai ke yeh bimari hamare mulk mein aa jayegi aur qatl aur zyadti ke jurm phail jayenge.

dialogue.ar: أَسْأَلُ اللهَ أَلّا يَحْدُثَ ذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: asʾalu llāha allā yaḥduthā dhālik
dialogue.en: I ask Allah that this does not happen.
dialogue.ur: Main Allah se dua karta hoon ke aisa na ho.

dialogue.ar: أَحْسَنْتَ؛ فَالحَياةُ لا تُساوي شَيْئاً بِلا أَمْنٍ.
dialogue.tr: aḥsanta; fa-l-ḥayātu lā tusāwī shayʾan bilā amn
dialogue.en: Well said; life is worth nothing without security.
dialogue.ur: Aap ne theek kaha; amn ke bina zindagi kuch bhi nahin.

dialogue.ar: أَدامَ اللهُ عَلَيْنا نِعْمَةَ الأَمْنِ.
dialogue.tr: adāma llāhu ʿalaynā niʿmata l-amn
dialogue.en: May Allah keep the blessing of security upon us.
dialogue.ur: Allah hum par amn ki nemat qaim rakhe.

dialogue.ar: آمين.
dialogue.tr: āmīn
dialogue.en: Ameen.
dialogue.ur: Aameen.

q.en: What did the friends talk about?
q.ur: Dono doston ne kis baare mein baat ki?

options: A bank theft shown on the news

q.en: Who arrested the criminals after a few hours?
q.ur: Chand ghanton baad mujrimon ko kis ne pakda?
q.ar: مَنْ قَبَضَ عَلى المُجْرِمينَ بَعْدَ ساعاتٍ؟

q.en: What does «الأَمْنُ» mean?
q.ur: «الأَمْنُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: According to Jaafar, life without security is:
q.ur: Jaafar ke mutabiq amn ke bina zindagi:
q.ar: قالَ جَعْفَرٌ إِنَّ الحَياةَ بِلا أَمْنٍ...

q.en: How do you say «blessing»?
q.ur: «Nemat» ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُقالُ لِلخَيْرِ الَّذي يُنْعِمُ اللهُ بِهِ عَلَيْنا؟

title.ur: Noon saakin aur tanween ka idgham

intro.en: A rule of recitation. When a silent noon (نْ) or tanween comes before one of six letters, يَرْمُلُون (ي ر م ل و ن), it is merged into the next letter. Example: مَنْ يَعْمَلْ is read like مَيَّعْمَلْ.
intro.ur: Tilawat ka ek qaida. Jab noon saakin (نْ) ya tanween ke baad in 6 huroof mein se koi aaye: ي ر م ل و ن (yarmaloon), to woh agle harf mein mil jata hai. Misal: مَنْ يَعْمَلْ ko aise parha jata hai jaise مَيَّعْمَلْ.
intro.ar: قاعِدَةٌ مِنْ قَواعِدِ التِّلاوَةِ: إِذا جاءَتْ نونٌ ساكِنَةٌ أَوْ تَنْوينٌ قَبْلَ أَحَدِ الحُروفِ السِّتَّةِ «يَرْمُلونَ» (ي ر م ل و ن) فَإِنَّها تُدْغَمُ في الحَرْفِ الَّذي بَعْدَها. مِثالٌ: «مَنْ يَعْمَلْ» تُقْرَأُ «مَيَّعْمَلْ».

vocab.ur: idgham, harf ka dusre harf mein milna

vocab.en: the six merge letters: ي ر م ل و ن

q.en: Which letters merge with a silent noon or tanween?
q.ur: Noon saakin ya tanween kin huroof mein mil jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حُروفٍ تُدْغَمُ فيها النّونُ السّاكِنَةُ وَالتَّنْوينُ؟

options: ي ر م ل و ن
ب ت ث ج ح خ
أ ب ت ث ج ح
ك ف ق س ش ص

q.en: How many letters are in the rule?
q.ur: Is qaide mein kitne huroof hain?

q.en: What is the memory word for these letters?
q.ur: In huroof ko yaad rakhne ka lafz kya hai?
q.ar: ما الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَجْمَعُ هذِهِ الحُروفَ لِلْحِفْظِ؟

q.en: What does «إِدْغام» mean?
q.ur: «إِدْغام» ka matlab kya hai?

options: Merging a letter into the next
options_ar: إِدْخالُ حَرْفٍ في الحَرْفِ الَّذي بَعْدَهُ

intro.en: After numbers 11 to 90 the counted thing (tamyīz) is singular and ends with fatha-tanween, e.g. أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً (eleven planets). After 100 and 1000 it is singular and in the genitive, e.g. مِئَةُ طالِبٍ (a hundred students).
intro.ur: 11 se 90 tak ke adaad ke baad ginti wali cheez (tamyeez) wahid hoti hai aur mansoob (fatha ke saath tanween), jaise أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً (gyarah sitare). 100 aur 1000 ke baad woh wahid aur majroor hoti hai, jaise مِئَةُ طالِبٍ (sau talib-ilm).
intro.ar: بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ١١ إِلى ٩٩ يَكونُ المَعْدودُ (التَّمْييزُ) مُفْرَداً مَنْصوباً، مِثْلَ: أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً. وَبَعْدَ ١٠٠ وَ١٠٠٠ يَكونُ مُفْرَداً مَجْروراً، مِثْلَ: مِئَةُ طالِبٍ.

q.en: After numbers 11 to 90 the counted noun is:
q.ur: 11 se 90 ke baad tamyeez hoti hai:
q.ar: بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ١١ إِلى ٩٩ يَكونُ المَعْدودُ...

q.en: After 100 and 1000 the counted noun is:
q.ur: 100 aur 1000 ke baad tamyeez hoti hai:

q.en: Which is correct?
q.ur: Kaun sa durust hai?

q.en: Which is correct?
q.ur: Kaun sa durust hai?

intro.en: You listen to a news item about eight men who robbed money from a plane in Brazil, then practise asking and answering questions about crime in your country.
intro.ur: Pehle ek khabar suni jati hai: Brazil mein aath aadmiyon ne jahaz ke paison ki chori ki. Phir jurm ke baare mein sawal jawab ki mashq hai.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنْ ثَمانِيَةِ رِجالٍ سَرَقوا أَمْوالاً مِنْ طائِرَةٍ في البَرازيلِ، ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى أَسْئِلَةٍ وَأَجْوِبَةٍ عَنِ الجَريمَةِ في بَلَدِكَ.

dialogue.ar: ثَمانِيَةُ رِجالٍ.
dialogue.tr: thamāniyatu rijāl
dialogue.en: Eight men.
dialogue.ur: Aath aadmi.

dialogue.ar: في البَرازيلِ.
dialogue.tr: fi l-barāzīl
dialogue.en: In Brazil.
dialogue.ur: Brazil mein.

dialogue.ar: كانَ بِها اثْنانِ وَسَبْعونَ شَخْصاً.
dialogue.tr: kāna bihā ithnāni wa-sabʿūna shakhṣan
dialogue.en: There were seventy-two people on it.
dialogue.ur: Us mein bahattar afraad the.

dialogue.ar: هَبَطَتِ الطّائِرَةُ في مَطارٍ في الرِّيفِ.
dialogue.tr: habaṭati ṭ-ṭāʾiratu fī maṭārin fi r-rīf
dialogue.en: The plane landed at an airport in the countryside.
dialogue.ur: Jahaz dehat ke ek hawai adde par utra.

dialogue.ar: هَرَبوا في سَيّارَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: harabū fī sayyāratin ṣaghīra
dialogue.en: They escaped in a small car.
dialogue.ur: Woh ek chhoti gaari mein bhaag gaye.

dialogue.ar: ذَهَبوا بِالأَمْوالِ.
dialogue.tr: dhahabū bi-l-amwāl
dialogue.en: They went away with the money.
dialogue.ur: Woh paise le kar chale gaye.

q.en: How many men were in the robbery news?
q.ur: Khabar mein kitne aadmi the?
q.ar: كَمْ رَجُلاً كانوا في خَبَرِ السَّرِقَةِ؟

q.en: In which country did it happen?
q.ur: Yeh kis mulk mein hua?

q.en: How did they escape?
q.ur: Woh kaise bhaage?

q.en: What does «الأَمْوال» mean?
q.ur: «الأَمْوال» ka matlab?

intro.en: A reading about why wars happen, how the League of Nations and the United Nations were created to keep peace, and why many UN decisions are not carried out.
intro.ur: Ek tehreer ke jang kyun hoti hai, Usbat-ul-Umam aur Aqwam-e-Muttahida peace ke liye kaise bane, aur un ke kai faislon par amal kyun nahin hota.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ أَسْبابِ الحُروبِ، وَكَيْفَ أُنْشِئَتْ عُصْبَةُ الأُمَمِ ثُمَّ الأُمَمُ المُتَّحِدَةُ لِحِفْظِ السَّلامِ، وَلِماذا لا تُنَفَّذُ كَثيرٌ مِنْ قَراراتِها.

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ كُلُّ إِنْسانٍ إِلى أَنْ يَعيشَ في أَمْنٍ وَسَلامٍ؛ وَمَعَ ذَلِكَ تَحْدُثُ الحُروبُ في كُلِّ مَكانٍ مِنَ العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju kullu insānin ilā an yaʿīsha fī amnin wa-salām; wa-maʿa dhālika taḥduthu l-ḥurūbu fī kulli makānin mina l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: Every person needs to live in security and peace; yet wars happen everywhere in the world.
dialogue.ur: Har insan ko amn aur salamati se rehna chahiye; phir bhi duniya ki har jagah jang hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهَا هِيَ وَسائِلُ الإِعْلامِ تَنْقُلُ لَنا كُلَّ ساعَةٍ أَخْبارَ الحُروبِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-hā hiya wasāʾilu l-iʿlāmi tanqulu lanā kulla sāʿatin akhbāra l-ḥurūb
dialogue.en: The media bring us news of wars every hour.
dialogue.ur: Media hamein har ghante jang ki khabrein pohanchata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالحَرْبُ لَيْسَتْ أَمْراً جَديداً؛ فَالتّارِيخُ يُحَدِّثُنا عَنْ حُروبٍ كَثيرَةٍ وَقَعَتْ في الماضي وَأَضْعَفَتْ حَضاراتِ الإِنْسانِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-ḥarbu laysat amran jadīdan; fa-t-tārīkhu yuḥaddithunā ʿan ḥurūbin kathīratin waqaʿat fi l-māḍī wa-aḍʿafat ḥaḍārāti l-insān
dialogue.en: War is nothing new; history tells us of many wars in the past that weakened human civilisations.
dialogue.ur: Jang koi nai cheez nahin; tareekh hamein maazi ki kai jangon ke baare mein batati hai jinhon ne insani tehzeebon ko kamzor kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ انْتِهاءِ الحَرْبِ العالَمِيَّةِ الأُولى سَنَةَ ١٩١٨م، أُنْشِئَتْ عُصْبَةُ الأُمَمِ، وَكانَ الهَدَفُ مِنْها حِفْظَ السَّلامِ في العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-baʿda intihāʾi l-ḥarbi l-ʿālamiyyati l-ūlā sanata 1918m, unshiʾat ʿuṣbatu l-umam, wa-kāna l-hadafu minhā ḥifẓa s-salāmi fi l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: After the end of the First World War in 1918, the League of Nations was founded, with the goal of keeping peace in the world.
dialogue.ur: 1918 mein pehli jang-e-azeem ke khatm hone ke baad Usbat-ul-Umam bani, jis ka maqsad duniya mein amn qaim rakhna tha.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ انْتِهاءِ الحَرْبِ العالَمِيَّةِ الثّانِيَةِ سَنَةَ ١٩٤٥م، أُنْشِئَتْ مُنَظَّمَةُ الأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ لِتَحُلَّ مَكانَ عُصْبَةِ الأُمَمِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-baʿda intihāʾi l-ḥarbi l-ʿālamiyyati th-thāniya sanata 1945m, unshiʾat munaẓẓamatu l-umami l-muttaḥida li-taḥulla makāna ʿuṣbati l-umam
dialogue.en: After the Second World War ended in 1945, the United Nations was founded to replace the League of Nations.
dialogue.ur: 1945 mein doosri jang-e-azeem ke baad Aqwam-e-Muttahida bani taa-ke Usbat-ul-Umam ki jagah le.

dialogue.ar: وَيَبْحَثُ مَجْلِسُ الأَمْنِ في المُنازَعاتِ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ، وَيَفْرِضُ عُقوباتٍ عَلَى الدُّوَلِ المُعْتَدِيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yabḥathu majlisu l-amni fi l-munāzaʿāti bayna d-duwal, wa-yafriḍu ʿuqūbātin ʿalā d-duwali l-muʿtadiya
dialogue.en: The Security Council looks into disputes between states and imposes penalties on aggressor states.
dialogue.ur: Security Council mulkon ke jhagron par ghaur karta hai aur zyadti karne wale mulkon par saza lagata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتُتَّهَمُ الأُمَمُ المُتَّحِدَةُ بِأَنَّها أَصْبَحَتْ ضَعيفَةً، لا حَوْلَ لَها وَلا قُوَّةَ، لِأَنَّ بَعْضَ الدُّوَلِ تُهَيْمِنُ عَلَيْها.
dialogue.tr: wa-tuttahamu l-umamu l-muttaḥidatu bi-annahā aṣbaḥat ḍaʿīfa, lā ḥawla lahā wa-lā quwwa, li-anna baʿḍa d-duwali tuhayminu ʿalayhā
dialogue.en: The UN is accused of having become weak and powerless because some states dominate it.
dialogue.ur: Aqwam-e-Muttahida par ilzam hai ke woh kamzor ho gayi hai kyunke kuch mulk us par chhaye hue hain.

q.en: When was the League of Nations founded?
q.ur: Usbat-ul-Umam kab bani?

q.en: What was the goal of the League of Nations?
q.ur: Usbat-ul-Umam ka maqsad kya tha?

q.en: Which body looks into disputes between states?
q.ur: Mulkon ke jhagron par kaun ghaur karta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جِهَةٍ تَنْظُرُ في النِّزاعاتِ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ؟

q.en: Why is the UN accused of weakness?

intro.en: When we call someone with يا, the person called is the munādā. If it is a single name or a specific person, it ends with damma and is not changed: يا مُحَمَّدُ. If it is an idāfa phrase or a non-specific noun, it takes fatha: يا عَبْدَ اللهِ، يا رَجُلاً.
intro.ur: Jab hum يا se kisi ko pukarte hain to pukare gaye ko munaada kehte hain. Agar woh ek naam ya muayyan shakhs ho to damma par mabni hota hai: يا مُحَمَّدُ. Agar mudaaf ho ya ghair muayyan ho to mansoob (fatha) hota hai: يا عَبْدَ اللهِ، يا رَجُلاً.
intro.ar: إِذا نادَيْنا شَخْصاً بِـ «يا» فَهُوَ المُنادى. إِنْ كانَ عَلَماً مُفْرَداً أَوْ مَعْرِفَةً مُفْرَدَةً بُنِيَ عَلى الضَّمِّ: يا مُحَمَّدُ. وَإِنْ كانَ مُضافاً أَوْ نَكِرَةً غَيْرَ مَقْصودَةٍ نُصِبَ: يا عَبْدَ اللهِ، يا رَجُلاً.

vocab.en: first word of an idāfa phrase

intro.en: Salah, Masoud and Ziyad discuss why crime increases. They mention weak laws, the media, poverty and hunger, and say that protecting security is everyone's responsibility. Two verses of the Qur'an are quoted.
intro.ur: Salah, Masood aur Ziyad baat karte hain ke jurm kyun barhta hai: kamzor qanoon, media, gareebi aur bhook. Aakhir mein kehte hain ke amn ki hifazat har shehri ki zimmedari hai. Is mein Quran ki do ayaat bhi hain.
intro.ar: يَتَناقَشُ صَلاحٌ وَمَسْعودٌ وَزِيادٌ في أَسْبابِ اِزْدِيادِ الجَريمَةِ: ضَعْفُ القَوانينِ وَوَسائِلُ الإِعْلامِ وَالفَقْرُ وَالجوعُ، وَيَقولونَ إِنَّ حِفْظَ الأَمْنِ مَسْؤولِيَّةُ الجَميعِ. وَيَرِدُ في الحِوارِ آيَتانِ مِنَ القُرْآنِ.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ سُؤالٌ يَشْغَلُ بالي كَثيراً: لِماذا زادَتْ نِسْبَةُ الجَريمَةِ في العالَمِ؟
dialogue.tr: hunāka suʾālun yashghalu bālī kathīran: li-mādhā zādat nisbatu l-jarīmati fi l-ʿālam?
dialogue.en: There is a question that occupies my mind a lot: why has the rate of crime risen in the world?
dialogue.ur: Ek sawal mujhe bahut sochne par majboor karta hai: duniya mein jurm ki sharah kyun barh gayi?

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ أَسْبابٌ كَثيرَةٌ، مِنْها: أَنَّ القَوانينَ أَصْبَحَتْ غَيْرَ رادِعَةٍ، فَالمُجْرِمُ يُسْجَنُ سَنَواتٍ، ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ لِيَرْتَكِبَ جَرائِمَ أُخْرى أَكْبَرَ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka asbābun kathīra, minhā: anna l-qawānīna aṣbaḥat ghayra rādiʿa, fa-l-mujrimu yusjanu sanawātin thumma yakhruju li-yartakiba jarāʾima ukhrā akbar
dialogue.en: There are many causes, among them that the laws have become non-deterrent: the criminal is jailed for years, then comes out to commit bigger crimes.
dialogue.ur: Kai asbaab hain, un mein se: qanoon rokne wale nahin rahe; mujrim saalon jail mein rehta hai phir nikal kar aur bade jurm karta hai.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ وَضَعَ الإِسْلامُ الحُدودَ؛ لِحِمايَةِ المُجْتَمَعِ. قالَ تَعالى: ﴿وَلَكُمْ في القِصاصِ حَياةٌ يا أُولِي الأَلْبابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقونَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: laqad waḍaʿa l-islāmu l-ḥudūd; li-ḥimāyati l-mujtamaʿ. qāla taʿālā: wa-lakum fi l-qiṣāṣi ḥayātun yā ulī l-albābi laʿallakum tattaqūn
dialogue.en: Islam laid down the hudood to protect society. Allah says: «And in retribution there is life for you, O people of understanding, that you may become righteous.»
dialogue.ur: Islam ne muashre ki hifazat ke liye hudood muqarrar kiye. Allah ta'ala farmata hai: «Aur tumhare liye qisas mein zindagi hai, aye aqal walo, taa-ke tum parhezgar bano.»

dialogue.ar: يُؤَيِّدُ ذَلِكَ أَنَّ الجَريمَةَ تَزْدادُ، كُلَّما أَمِنَ المُجْرِمُ العِقابَ.
dialogue.tr: yuʾayyidu dhālika anna l-jarīmata tazdādu, kullamā amina l-mujrimu l-ʿiqāb
dialogue.en: This is supported by the fact that crime increases whenever the criminal feels safe from punishment.
dialogue.ur: Is ki tasdeeq is se hoti hai ke jab mujrim saza se befikr ho jata hai to jurm barhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ الأَسْبابِ عِنْدي، أَنَّ وَسائِلَ الإِعْلامِ تُشَجِّعُ عَلَى الجَريمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-mina l-asbābi ʿindī, anna wasāʾila l-iʿlāmi tushajjiʿu ʿalā l-jarīma
dialogue.en: Among the causes, in my view, is that the media encourage crime.
dialogue.ur: Meri raye mein ek sabab yeh hai ke media jurm ki hausla afzai karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ يَكونُ مِنَ الأَسْبابِ انْتِشارُ الفَقْرِ، وَالجوعُ في المُجْتَمَعِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-qad yakūnu mina l-asbābi intishāru l-faqr, wa-l-jūʿu fi l-mujtamaʿ
dialogue.en: Another cause may be the spread of poverty and hunger in society.
dialogue.ur: Aur ek sabab gareebi ka phailna aur muashre mein bhook ho sakti hai.

dialogue.ar: صَدَقْتَ، فَالأَمْنُ وَالغِذاءُ مِنْ أَهَمِّ النِّعَمِ. قالَ تَعالى: ﴿فَلْيَعْبُدوا رَبَّ هَذا البَيْتِ الَّذي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جوعٍ وَآمَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ﴾.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqta, fa-l-amnu wa-l-ghidhāʾu min ahammi n-niʿam. qāla taʿālā: fa-l-yaʿbudū rabba hādha l-bayti lladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin wa-āmanahum min khawf
dialogue.en: You are right; security and food are among the most important blessings. Allah says: «So let them worship the Lord of this House, who fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear.»
dialogue.ur: Aap ne sach kaha; amn aur khana sab se aham nematon mein se hain. Allah ta'ala farmata hai: «Pas unhein chahiye ke is ghar ke Rab ki ibadat karein, jis ne unhein bhook mein khana khilaya aur khauf se aman diya.»

dialogue.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ نَتَعاوَنَ جَميعاً عَلى حِفْظِ الأَمْنِ؛ فَحِفْظُ الأَمْنِ لَيْسَ مَسْؤولِيَّةَ رِجالِ الأَمْنِ وَحْدَهُمْ، وَإِنَّما مَسْؤولِيَّةُ كُلِّ مُواطِنٍ.
dialogue.tr: yajibu an nataʿāwana jamīʿan ʿalā ḥifẓi l-amn; fa-ḥifẓu l-amni laysa masʾūliyyata rijāli l-amni waḥdahum, wa-innamā masʾūliyyatu kulli muwāṭin
dialogue.en: We must all cooperate to keep security; guarding security is not the duty of security men alone, but of every citizen.
dialogue.ur: Hamein amn ki hifazat mein sab ko mil kar madad karni chahiye; yeh sirf police ki zimmedari nahin, balkeh har shehri ki zimmedari hai.

vocab.ur: hum mil kar madad karte hain

intro.en: Five nouns change their ending with letters: أَبو، أَخو، حَمو، فو، ذو. They end with و when marfoo (جاءَ أَبو صَلاحٍ), with ا when mansoob (يا أَبا صَلاحٍ) and with ي when majroor (أَمْرُكُمْ يَشْغَلُ بالَ أَبيكُمْ). This works when the noun is singular and not attached to «my» (ي).
intro.ur: Paanch ism hain jin ki akhri harkat huroof se badalti hai: أَبو، أَخو، حَمو، فو، ذو. Marfoo ho to و (جاءَ أَبو صَلاحٍ), mansoob ho to ا (يا أَبا صَلاحٍ) aur majroor ho to ي (أَبيكُمْ). Shart yeh hai ke woh wahid hon aur ي mutakallim ki taraf mudaaf na hon.
intro.ar: خَمْسَةُ أَسْماءٍ تُعْرَبُ بِالحُروفِ: أَبو، أَخو، حَمو، فو، ذو. تُرْفَعُ بِالواوِ (جاءَ أَبو صَلاحٍ)، وَتُنْصَبُ بِالأَلِفِ (يا أَبا صَلاحٍ)، وَتُجَرُّ بِالياءِ (أَمْرُكُمْ يَشْغَلُ بالَ أَبيكُمْ). وَذلِكَ إِذا كانَتْ مُفْرَدَةً مُضافَةً إِلى غَيْرِ ياءِ المُتَكَلِّمِ.

q.en: The five nouns end with و when they are:

q.ar: تَنْتَهي الأَسْماءُ الخَمْسَةُ بِالواوِ عِنْدَما تَكونُ...

intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكَلامِ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنْ عُقوباتِ القَتْلِ وَالسَّرِقَةِ وَالاِغْتِصابِ في بَلَدِكَ وَفي الإِسْلامِ، وَلِماذا جَعَلَ الإِسْلامُ عُقوبَةَ المُجْرِمينَ رادِعَةً. ثُمَّ نَشاطٌ جَماعِيٌّ عَنْ أَسْبابِ الجَريمَةِ في المُجْتَمَعِ.

title.en: The effect of security on life

intro.en: A reading about how security brings happiness, health and food, how peaceful countries grow, and the three kinds of countries in the world today. It includes an Ayah and a Hadith about security.
intro.ur: Ek tehreer ke amn insan ko khushi, sehat aur ghiza deta hai, pur-aman mulk kaise taraqqi karte hain, aur aaj duniya mein teen qism ke mulk kaun se hain. Is mein Quran ki ayat aur ek hadees bhi hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ أَثَرِ الأَمْنِ: كَيْفَ يَجْلِبُ السَّعادَةَ وَالصِّحَّةَ وَالطَّعامَ، وَكَيْفَ تَنْمو الدُّوَلُ الآمِنَةُ، وَأَنْواعُ الدُّوَلِ الثَّلاثَةُ اليَوْمَ. وَفيهِ آيَةٌ وَحَديثٌ عَنِ الأَمْنِ.

dialogue.ar: ﴿الَّذينَ آمَنوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسوا إيمانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ أُولَئِكَ لَهُمُ الأَمْنُ وَهُمْ مُهْتَدونَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: alladhīna āmanū wa-lam yalbisū īmānahum bi-ẓulmin ulāʾika lahumu l-amnu wa-hum muhtadūn
dialogue.en: Those who believed and did not mix their faith with wrongdoing, for them is security, and they are guided.
dialogue.ur: Jo log iman laye aur apne iman mein zulm ki milawat nahin ki, unhi ke liye amn hai aur wahi hidayat yafta hain.

dialogue.ar: يَعيشُ الإِنْسانُ سَعيداً في حَياتِهِ، مُطْمَئِنّاً عَلى نَفْسِهِ، وَمالِهِ، وَأَهْلِهِ، إِذا تَوَفَّرَتْ في مُجْتَمَعِهِ ثَلاثَةُ أُمورٍ: الأَمْنُ، وَالصِّحَّةُ، وَالغِذاءُ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿīshu l-insānu saʿīdan fī ḥayātihi, muṭmaʾinnan ʿalā nafsihi, wa-mālihi, wa-ahlihi, idhā tawaffarat fī mujtamaʿihi thalāthatu umūr: al-amnu, wa-ṣ-ṣiḥḥatu, wa-l-ghidhāʾ
dialogue.en: A person lives happily, feeling safe about himself, his wealth and his family, if three things are available in his society: security, health and food.
dialogue.ur: Insan khush rehta hai, apni jaan, maal aur ahl ke baare mein mutmaeen, agar uske muashre mein teen cheezein hon: amn, sehat aur ghiza.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمْ آمِناً في سِرْبِهِ، مُعافىً في جَسَدِهِ، عِنْدَهُ قوتُ يَوْمِهِ، فَكَأَنَّما حيزَتْ لَهُ الدُّنْيا بِحَذافيرِها».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: man aṣbaḥa minkum āminan fī sirbihi, muʿāfan fī jasadihi, ʿindahu qūtu yawmihi, fa-ka-annamā ḥīzat lahu d-dunyā bi-ḥadhāfīrihā
dialogue.en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever among you wakes up safe in his home, healthy in his body, with his day's food, it is as if the whole world was gathered for him.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Tum mein se jo subah is haal mein uthe ke apne ghar mein aman se ho, jism mein sehatmand ho aur uske paas us din ki khurak ho, to goya uske liye poori duniya jama kar di gayi.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَما تَعيشُ البِلادُ في أَمْنٍ وَسَلامٍ، يَتَحَقَّقُ الاسْتِقْرارُ؛ فَتَنْشَطُ عَمَلِيَّةُ التَّنْمِيَةِ، وَيَتَّجِهُ النّاسُ إِلى البِناءِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿindamā taʿīshu l-bilādu fī amnin wa-salām, yataḥaqqaqu l-istiqrār; fa-tanshaṭu ʿamaliyyatu t-tanmiya, wa-yattajihu n-nāsu ilā l-bināʾ
dialogue.en: When a country lives in security and peace, stability is achieved; development becomes active and people turn to building.
dialogue.ur: Jab mulk amn aur salamati mein rehta hai to istehkam aata hai; taraqqi tez hoti hai aur log tameer ki taraf lagte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا إِذا حَلَّتِ الجَريمَةُ مَكانَ الأَمْنِ، فَتُحْرَمُ البِلادُ مِنَ الاسْتِقْرارِ، وَتَتَوَقَّفُ عَمَلِيَّةُ التَّنْمِيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā idhā ḥallati l-jarīmatu makāna l-amn, fa-tuḥramu l-bilādu mina l-istiqrār, wa-tatawaqqafu ʿamaliyyatu t-tanmiya
dialogue.en: But if crime takes the place of security, the country is deprived of stability and development stops.
dialogue.ur: Lekin jab jurm amn ki jagah le leta hai to mulk istehkam se mehroom ho jata hai aur taraqqi ruk jati hai.

dialogue.ar: الدُّوَلُ ثَلاثَةُ أَقْسامٍ: دُوَلٌ فيها أَمْنٌ وَسَلامٌ، وَدُوَلٌ لا تَعْرِفُ السَّلامَ، وَدُوَلٌ لَيْسَتْ في سَلامٍ دائِمٍ.
dialogue.tr: ad-duwalu thalāthatu aqsām: duwalun fīhā amnun wa-salām, wa-duwalun lā taʿrifu s-salām, wa-duwalun laysat fī salāmin dāʾim
dialogue.en: Countries are of three kinds: countries with security and peace, countries that do not know peace, and countries not in lasting peace.
dialogue.ur: Mulk teen qism ke hain: jin mein amn aur salamati hai, jo salamati ko jante hi nahin, aur jin mein hamesha ka aman nahin.

dialogue.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ تَتَوَقَّفَ الحُروبُ في جَميعِ أَنْحاءِ العالَمِ، حَتّى يَعُمَّ السَّلامُ الأَرْضَ.
dialogue.tr: yajibu an tatawaqqafa l-ḥurūbu fī jamīʿi anḥāʾi l-ʿālam, ḥattā yaʿumma s-salāmu l-arḍ
dialogue.en: Wars must stop in all parts of the world, until peace covers the earth.
dialogue.ur: Duniya ke har hissay mein jangein ruk jani chahiyen, yahan tak ke zameen par salamati aam ho jaye.

q.en: Which three things make a person happy and reassured?
q.ur: Kaun si teen cheezein insan ko khush aur mutmaeen rakhti hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ ثَلاثَةِ أُمورٍ تَجْعَلُ الإِنْسانَ سَعيداً مُطْمَئِنّاً؟

title.en: The hāl: describing how an action happened

intro.en: The hāl is an indefinite, mansoob noun that shows the state of the doer or of the object while the action happens. Its owner is definite. It answers the question: How did the action happen? Example: صَلَّتِ المَريضَةُ جالِسَةً – the sick woman prayed sitting.
intro.ur: Haal ek nakira mansoob ism hai jo kaam hote waqt fail ya maful ki haalat batata hai; us ka sahib-ul-haal maarifa hota hai. Yeh is sawal ka jawab hai: kaam kaise hua? Misal: صَلَّتِ المَريضَةُ جالِسَةً – beemar aurat ne baith kar namaz parhi.
intro.ar: الحالُ اِسْمٌ نَكِرَةٌ مَنْصوبٌ يُبَيِّنُ هَيْئَةَ الفاعِلِ أَوِ المَفْعولِ بِهِ وَقْتَ حُدوثِ الفِعْلِ، وَصاحِبُهُ مَعْرِفَةٌ. يُجيبُ عَنِ السُّؤالِ: كَيْفَ حَدَثَ الفِعْلُ؟ مِثالٌ: صَلَّتِ المَريضَةُ جالِسَةً.

q.en: The hāl answers which question?
q.ur: Haal kis sawal ka jawab hai?

q.en: The hāl is always:
q.ur: Haal hamesha hota hai:

intro.en: Writing practice. You write two paragraphs: one about a country that lives in security and peace, and one about a country that lives in continuous wars. Then you write a short essay called الأَمْنُ وَالسَّلامُ, using the unit's texts for help.
intro.ur: Likhne ki mashq. Do paragraph likhein: ek aise mulk ke baare mein jo amn aur salamati mein hai, aur doosra aise mulk ke baare mein jo musalsal jangon mein hai. Phir unit ki tehreeron se madad le kar ek mazmoon «الأَمْنُ وَالسَّلامُ» par likhein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: فِقْرَتانِ، إِحْداهُما عَنْ بَلَدٍ يَعيشُ في أَمْنٍ وَسَلامٍ، وَالأُخْرى عَنْ بَلَدٍ يَعيشُ في حُروبٍ مُتَواصِلَةٍ. ثُمَّ مَوْضوعٌ قَصيرٌ بِعُنْوانِ «الأَمْنُ وَالسَّلامُ» مُسْتَعيناً بِنُصوصِ الوِحْدَةِ.

title.en: Handwriting and spelling: the extra waw
title.ur: Khat aur imla: waw ka izafa

intro.en: Handwriting in ruq'a script with a line of poetry about learning. Spelling rule: an extra و is written but not pronounced in three places: أُولاءِ and أُولئِكَ, أُولو (meaning owners of), and at the end of عَمْرو when it is not mansoob with tanween.
intro.ur: Khat-e-ruqa mein ilm ke baare mein ek sher likhna. Imla ka qaida: teen jagah و likha jata hai magar parha nahin jata: أُولاءِ aur أُولئِكَ mein, أُولو (wale) mein, aur عَمْرو ke aakhir mein jab woh mansoob tanween wala na ho.
intro.ar: اُكْتُبْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ عَنِ التَّعَلُّمِ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ. وَقاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: تُكْتَبُ واوٌ زائِدَةٌ وَلا تُنْطَقُ في ثَلاثَةِ مَواضِعَ: «أُولاءِ» وَ«أُولئِكَ»، وَ«أُولو» بِمَعْنى أَصْحابِ، وَفي آخِرِ «عَمْرو» إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْصوباً مُنَوَّناً.

dialogue.ar: تَعَلَّمْ فَلَيْسَ المَرْءُ يُولَدُ عالِماً — وَلَيْسَ أَخو عِلْمٍ كَمَنْ هُوَ جاهِلُ.
dialogue.tr: taʿallam fa-laysa l-marʾu yūladu ʿāliman — wa-laysa akhū ʿilmin kaman huwa jāhil
dialogue.en: Learn, for no one is born knowing; the man of knowledge is not like the ignorant.
dialogue.ur: Seekho, kyunke koi paida hote hi aalim nahin hota; ilm wala jahil ke barabar nahin.

q.en: In how many places is an extra و written but not pronounced?
q.ur: Kitni jagah و likha jata hai magar parha nahin jata?
q.ar: في كَمْ مَوْضِعٍ تُكْتَبُ واوٌ زائِدَةٌ وَلا تُنْطَقُ؟

q.en: In which name is the final و not pronounced?
q.ur: Kis naam ke aakhir mein و nahin parha jata?
q.ar: في أَيِّ اسْمٍ لا تُنْطَقُ الواوُ الأَخيرَةُ؟

q.en: What does «الإِمْلاء» mean?
q.ur: «الإِمْلاء» ka matlab?

q.en: The poem line says to:
q.ur: Sher kehta hai:

options: Learn, nobody is born a scholar

intro.en: A review test for Units 13 and 14. You read short passages (the Islamic world, Al-Jahiz) and answer questions, then review spelling, numbers, word usage and the countries and meanings of words you have learned.
intro.ur: Unit 13 aur 14 ki dohrai ka imtihan. Chhote paragraph parh kar (Islami duniya, Al-Jahiz) sawalon ke jawab dein, phir imla, adaad, alfaaz aur unke maani ki dohrai karein.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارٌ لِمُراجَعَةِ الوِحْدَتَيْنِ ١٣ وَ١٤: تَقْرَأُ نُصوصاً قَصيرَةً (العالَمُ الإِسْلامِيُّ وَالجاحِظُ) وَتُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَتِها، ثُمَّ تُراجِعُ الإِمْلاءَ وَالأَعْدادَ وَاسْتِعْمالَ الكَلِماتِ وَالبُلْدانَ وَمَعانِيَ المُفْرَداتِ.

dialogue.ar: الدُّوَلُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ هِيَ الدُّوَلُ الَّتي يَزيدُ عَدَدُ المُسْلِمينَ فيها عَلى ٥٠٪ مِنْ عَدَدِ السُّكّانِ.
dialogue.tr: ad-duwalu l-islāmiyyatu hiya d-duwalu llatī yazīdu ʿadadu l-muslimīna fīhā ʿalā 50% min ʿadadi s-sukkān
dialogue.en: Islamic countries are those where the number of Muslims is more than 50% of the population.
dialogue.ur: Islami mulk woh hain jin mein musalmanon ki tadad aabadi ke 50 fisad se zyada ho.

dialogue.ar: وَيَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ هَذِهِ الدُّوَلِ أَرْبَعاً وَخَمْسينَ دَوْلَةً في آسيا وَإِفْريقيا وَأُوروبّا.
dialogue.tr: wa-yabluġhu ʿadadu hādhihi d-duwali arbaʿan wa-khamsīna dawlatan fī āsiyā wa-ifrīqiyā wa-ūrūbbā
dialogue.en: These countries number fifty-four, in Asia, Africa and Europe.
dialogue.ur: In mulkon ki tadad chauwan hai, Asia, Africa aur Europe mein.

dialogue.ar: وَيَتَكَلَّمُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ لُغَةً، أَضِفْ إِلى ذَلِكَ لُغَةَ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ الَّتي يُحِبُّ كُلُّ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَتَحَدَّثَ بِها.
dialogue.tr: wa-yatakallamu akthara min khamsa ʿashrata lughatan, aḍif ilā dhālika lughata l-qurʾāni l-karīm allatī yuḥibbu kullu muslimin an yataḥaddatha bihā
dialogue.en: They speak more than fifteen languages, in addition to the language of the Noble Qur'an which every Muslim loves to speak.
dialogue.ur: Woh pandrah se zyada zubanein bolte hain, is ke ilawa Quran-e-Kareem ki zuban jise har musalman bolna pasand karta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَقَعُ العالَمُ الإِسْلامِيُّ في أَهَمِّ المَناطِقِ في العالَمِ؛ فَهُوَ كَالقَلْبِ لِقارّاتِ العالَمِ القَديمِ.
dialogue.tr: yaqaʿu l-ʿālamu l-islāmiyyu fī ahammi l-manāṭiqi fi l-ʿālam; fa-huwa ka-l-qalbi li-qārrāti l-ʿālami l-qadīm
dialogue.en: The Islamic world lies in the most important regions of the world; it is like the heart of the continents of the old world.
dialogue.ur: Islami duniya duniya ke aham tareen ilaqon mein hai; woh purani duniya ke barrazamin ke liye dil ki tarah hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّ أَهَمَّ ثَرَواتِ العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ وَأَفْضَلَها الإِنْسانُ المُسْلِمُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-lākinna ahamma tharawāti l-ʿālami l-islāmiyyi wa-afḍalahā l-insānu l-muslim
dialogue.en: But the most important and best wealth of the Islamic world is the Muslim person.
dialogue.ur: Lekin Islami duniya ki sab se aham aur behtareen daulat musalman insan hai.

dialogue.ar: كانَ الجاحِظُ مِنْ كُتّابِ العَرَبِ المَشْهورينَ. وَعِنْدَما كانَ شاباً صَغيراً، كانَ يُحِبُّ القِراءَةَ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-jāḥiẓu min kuttābi l-ʿarabi l-mashhūrīn. wa-ʿindamā kāna shābban ṣaghīran, kāna yuḥibbu l-qirāʾata kathīran
dialogue.en: Al-Jahiz was one of the famous Arab writers. When he was a young man he loved reading very much.
dialogue.ur: Al-Jahiz mashhoor Arab adeebon mein se tha. Jab woh chhota naujawan tha to parhna bahut pasand karta tha.

q.en: When is a country called Islamic, according to the text?
q.ur: Tehreer ke mutabiq mulk Islami kab kehlata hai?
q.ar: مَتى يُسَمّى البَلَدُ إِسْلامِيّاً حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

options_ar: عِنْدَما يَزيدُ المُسْلِمونَ عَلى نِصْفِ السُّكّانِ

q.ur: Islami duniya ki sab se aham daulat kya hai?

q.ur: Al-Jahiz kaun tha?
